reviews.title: Great Overall Keyboard
reviews.comment:
This is a great keyboard. It combines everything I wanted in a keyboard and then some.
The cost was great for a bluetooth, wireless (corded is an option), multi-functional keyboard.
First thing that sticks out to me is the overall/initial quality after using this about a week. It is the perfect amount of weight and does not feel cheap. Everything works like it should.
Second thing is the sound of the keyboard. I type a lot daily for work and wanted a "membrane" that had a slightly softer or quieter keyboard typing experience. This gives you the perfect blend of "mechanical" keyboard style but without the loud, clacky sound that isn't fun for days where typing can be constant.
Third, it works with all my devices pretty seamlessly. Disconnecting and reconnecting to this device is VERY quick. It was somewhat unexpected honesty, but a welcome surprise. The battery life is decent, I have had to charge it once in one week of use, so I expect on and off use for 8 hours per day, to need to charge this once per week with my current setup.
Fourth, the placement of the keys initially I thought was a little odd, but you get used to it quickly when you come from a compact or full size keyboard, as this is some hybrid of both. It includes the num pad functionality of a larger keyboard and the compact style and size of smaller keyboards which is an awesome experience for me personally.
Fifth, and last is personalization. It gives you a lot of control over built in functions with two "modes" Gaming mode and Work mode which change/allow you to control how the backlighting works and option to map custom functions to the buttons on the top right of the keyboard "M1" "M2" and "M3." The keyboard also allows you to add/change colors, different lighting movement patterns, cool reaction function with the lighting when typing, and the option to keep a solid color, the brightness of the backlight, or the option to completely shut it off completely if you want for something like saving battery.
The two cons I could come up with for this product is the battery could be a bit better, like the higher 8,000 mAh battery Aula puts in their F99 wireless keyboard as this S99 is a 4,000 mAh battery.
The second is that there is no "Home" button, likely to make the keyboard more compact. However, that is the annoying part. I use the Home and End buttons everyday for work, and the lack of having one all week was bothering me. I did find out however, that the Fn+1 (num pad #1 key) does the same thing as the End key and the Fn+7(num pad #7 key) does the same thing as the Home key, so I am back in business but it is still an annoyance to not have the dedidated key.
TL;DR -
Pros:
1. Good quality product
2. Great quieter keyboard sound. Louder than basic keyboards, quieter than the "clack" of mechanical keyboards
3. Device compatibility is seamless
4. Key placement somewhat odd, but keyboard overall has a good compact size
5. Good personalization options
Cons:
1. Battery capacity may be an annoyance for higher usage (4,000 mAh)
2. No dedicated "Home" button. Found a workaround with turning num lock off and using Fn+1 and 7 keys on numpad.

reviews.title: Say less!
reviews.comment: I was very excited to get this keyboard. It was an upgrade from my last one and I love the red lighting that it has behind the keys. Not only does it look cool but it's helpful when you need to see in dark areas and you are typing. It makes for a great typing experience. This is a hearty keyboard too! It's clearly made really well and the durability doesn't have me questioning the product life on it. It may be durable but that doesn't take away from the portability of it. I can easily tuck it away into my laptop back and go where ever I need to with it. Finally... the compatibility... it was awesome to see the little plug in having it's own little place on the keyboard for traveling or storing. The moment I plugged it in to my computer it was on and ready to go. Keys type smooth, colors look great. It's def a buy!

reviews.title: Easy to Use, Sounds Great, Performs Perfectly
reviews.comment:
I'm very much enjoying this keyboard. It's been about one month since purchasing and beginning to use it.
I'm a daily keyboard user at work as a Braille Transcriber for a school district. I do a LOT of keyboard work.
The sound is much quieter than a basic keyboard, but also goes back and forth between a quieter typical keyboard and a "thocky" style sound. I enjoy the sound, and don't feel it's annoying. However I work alone most of the time so I'm not worried about how coworkers would react to the constant sound of my typing.
The keyboard uses a rechargeable battery via usb-c. You can also direct connect to your computer if you want. I charged the keyboard before using it for the first time and connect via bluetooth. No issues with connectivity. Since then, I have only had to charge it once, as it started getting low after 3 weeks. I left it charging for the weekend. Since then I've stuck to charging over the weekend every 2 weeks.
The keys themselves feel bouncy. There's a good tactile feedback when you strike a key. I haven't had any issues with keys sticking.
I did some fooling around with the keyboard while writing this to make sure my issues were still problems. However I was able to figure one out. The volume knob would not change the volume for me. Instead, turning the knob would change the brightness of the background light of the keyboard. I had given up on figuring out the volume but I've realized that I needed to hold down the knob until the Num and Caps lights blinked twice. Then I could adjust the volume. To go back to the light adjustment, hold down the knob again until the lights blink twice.
My ONLY issue with the keyboard is that it does go to sleep mode rather quickly. I think it's like 2 minutes of inactivity leads to the keyboard needing to be tapped a few times to wake up. My work computer requires me to tap the space bar in order to wake up the computer after inactivity. So first thing in the morning, or if I am only reading something on the computer versus typing something, when I go to type, then I'm hitting the spacebar or other keys randomly until the keyboard wakes up. It's such a minor inconvenience, but I wish there was a bit more time before the keyboard went to sleep.
Overall, I'm enjoying the keyboard! It's nice, seemingly durable, keyboard with a fun sound and lights and does the job for me.

reviews.title: great keyboard for beginners
reviews.comment: The keyboard was a surprisingly good find. It has a really creamy sound to the keys and the keys feel nice to press. For a membrane keyboard it's everything you could want. Setting up the bluetooth was very simple and connecting it via a cord is also very simple.
